lead: nothing in you is set to open, and nothing behind that is set to open either — the covering goes over what you keep, and then over the fact that anything is being kept at all.
sun: there is no weather in a room you are in, and nobody present connects those two facts. what gets done for people here is done before it is visible as doing — the call made a week early, the thing quietly paid, the person kept away from the door. so their account of the last ten years is that it has gone smoothly, which is accurate and is missing its cause.
moon: the covering does not stop at what is underneath it. it goes over the arrangement as well: no inner room anywhere in you where the accounting is kept, no version of a bad autumn that gets read anywhere, not even by you. what a hard year produces is not a record of a hard year. it produces a better cover, put up faster, with nothing on it that says why.
pull: cover over cover, doubled, and one point of contact holding up both of them. every person you have kept dry believes the climate around here is mild.
tension: a friend turns up with something to offer and finds nothing on you that opens inward. no refusal is issued — there is no aperture, no place a hand could go — and the offer comes away in the hand that brought it. self-sufficient is what they settle on, kindly. people who have known you thirty years have never once been let do a thing for you, and could not name what they were kept out of.
cost: whole decades go past in your vicinity with nobody having to know what a bad year looks like. the same covering runs over the support, so nothing reports on the one point everything stands on. when it goes it goes with everything above it, and the people underneath will not have a name for what happened, never having known they were under anything.

lead: the deeds moved four years ago, on a tuesday, and nobody who works in there has ever heard that date said aloud. what they are inside will stand whether or not you do.
sun: the covering is over the reason. six people know the ownership changed and none has been given the year that produced it — the winter it nearly went, what the hospital letter said, the arithmetic at four in the morning about where they land if you stop. so the change reads as tidiness, a careful person doing careful paperwork, and what it answered has never once been said in their hearing.
moon: what you put up for other people is made to outlast the reason it went up: proper materials, nothing provisional, no setting on it that expires the day you look elsewhere. The Chamber builds nothing for a season, so those rooms will carry six livelihoods in thirty years without anyone's goodwill being required. and because nothing in them ever gives, nothing in them ever comes up for discussion.
pull: everything you make for other people is built to survive you. what you are living under yourself went up in a week and stands on one pole, and only the first is on show.
tension: a person who builds like that must be standing on something similar. the assumption is in the room before you are, and it arrives as requests sized for an institution — the loan guaranteed, a year of somebody's rent, the job held open. each is answered, out of something far smaller than the asker pictures. saying otherwise puts the state of your own footing into the room, which is the exact event that tuesday was arranged to make unnecessary.
cost: six livelihoods now sit inside something that survives anybody's health, and the ones it will save will never learn it was arranged in a fright. none of it was built for the one who built it. you are still under a covering that went up fast, on a single point, and nobody has been shown what that point is or what is resting on it.

lead: seven people ended up somewhere they had no route into, and each tells it as a decision they made in a bad year. the crossing itself was never on show, to anybody, including to them.
sun: the passage works because you put something over it. a person halfway is at the worst they have been, and while they are under there no family member sees it, no future employer sees it, nobody who could write it down is admitted. seven of them spent a year each out of view while they changed, and the part of each story that would explain the arrival is the part that was covered.
moon: going ahead is the entire method, and the road is in one head. you know which turn takes people down because you went down it, and that knowing is in no form anybody could be handed — no criteria, no notes, nothing a second person could learn. the delivery finishes at the arrival, and each arrival closes the only account of how it was done.
pull: seven people got across on a road that exists in one person and is written nowhere. the cover is why it works, and why nobody can be sent along it after you.
tension: the woman who was passed over asks what the criteria were, and the question is a fair one. the honest answer is seven people at the worst months of their lives, not producible in an argument, not now and not in ten years. so favourites is what the choosing gets called, said with an edge, by colleagues who are entitled to be sceptical about a process nobody has ever been allowed to watch.
cost: no references, no paper, nothing a panel would have shortlisted, and a person gets taken the whole way into a life nobody predicted for them. none of it transfers. it runs on one person knowing the road and on nobody being able to look at the road, so the season you stop going ahead is the season the route stops existing, with people still at the near end.

lead: your sister was born with it and is fifty-one now, and there has been no month in that time when the arrangement round her paused, changed hands, or got described to anybody outside it.
sun: from any distance it is a close family, which is the only description ever offered. the rota, the money, the two nights a week that get called something else, the single name on every form — none of that is on show, and none of it is being withheld from anyone in particular. a covering does not produce an account of itself, and five decades of one produce five decades of nothing to read.
moon: there is no join anywhere in the length. nothing began, so nothing can be handed over at a beginning — the line was already tight by the time you were old enough to notice you were holding it. and the cord only does anything while both of its ends are hauling, so no reduced setting exists: no year at half strength, nothing between full tension and gone.
pull: five decades of it, never once slack, and the entire length running to one hand. there is no lighter version to drop to, and the setting below that one is not a setting.
tension: the family reads it as temperament — you were always the one who took things on — and the reading has fifty years of evidence, every bit of it produced by you. offers come in fortnights, because a fortnight is what a person can picture giving. the arrangement does not cut into fortnights, and saying why hands the entire account to whoever asked. so the fortnights get declined warmly, and the reading gets another year of proof.
cost: she has had a life with a kitchen in it instead of a corridor, uninterrupted, and no stranger has ever had to be told her history from the start. the length runs to one point of contact and always has. a year that takes you out does not reach her gradually. it reaches her as fifty-one years stopping inside a week.
